statements.statement: PLOS ONE has retracted this paper on phishing URL detection with an RNN-LSTM.
The editors cite concerns about peer review integrity and possible manipulation of the publication process.
The editors say these concerns call the validity and provenance of the results into question.
The whole paper is affected, including its accuracy and F1 claims, so it should not be relied on or cited as support.
The draft cites Dutta [14] in Section 3 as 'the main evidence' for choosing an LSTM, and in Section 4 as the source of the starting model settings.
PLOS ONE retracted the whole paper and says the validity and provenance of its results are in question.
Both uses of Dutta [14] are affected by the retraction.
Section 3 rests on the retracted accuracy and F1 claims.
Section 3 skipped a model-selection study because of the retracted claims.
Section 4 takes parameter values from the paper and plans to read the draft's results against its published numbers.
Since the paper is both key evidence and a source of methods, the impact is high.
Both the LSTM choice (Section 3) and the starting settings (Section 4) rest on a paper that PLOS ONE has retracted.
